title: Rory and the Starry Blossom Hill
verses:
The sun dipped away as the evening grew still,
And Rory walked up to the top of the hill.
The blossoms were closing their petals of white,
To welcome the peace of the velvety night.

Then Tilly stepped up with a bundle of fern,
For curling up cozy when stars start to burn.
And Ricky hopped softly and patted the ground,
Without any trouble or mischievous sound.

High over the ridge, Nia floated with grace,
To look for the softest and quietest place.
And Benny leaned low as he rested his head,
While gathering leaves for a giant green bed.

Now Psittaco chirped from a branch in the breeze,
Then fluttered right down through the whispering trees.
He landed on Rory and tucked in his wings,
To listen to lullabies night softly sings.

The stars drifted out in the velvety blue,
The clover was sprinkled with sparkles of dew.
Then Rory curled gently beside all his friends,
To rest as the journey of daytime now ends.

Their heavy eyes closed as the crickets sang low,
Their breathing turned easy and steady and slow.
Sweet dreams filled the hilltop with warm golden light,
And Rory fell fast into slumber tonight.
